\begin{center}\Large\bfseries Appendix A. A Sample Sovereign Deep-Technology Portfolio for Kazakhstan\end{center}

\vspace{2pt}
This appendix demonstrates Work Package~2 (the Sovereign Deep-Technology Portfolio)
as a working artifact rather than a proposed one. Using the \texttt{scientifiq.ai}
platform, we queried the more than 10,000 indexed publications affiliated with
institutions in the Republic of Kazakhstan, scored each along the platform's
forward-looking \emph{commercial}, \emph{scientific}, and \emph{social} potential
measures, ranked them by predicted commercial potential, and selected a
diversified set---capped per field and per institution---so that the result is a
genuinely spread set of bets rather than a single cluster. Scores are reported on
a $0$--$100$ scale. The full portfolio, and a licensing brief for any single item
(market, comparable science, and surrounding patent landscape), can be generated
on demand.
